additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Mr. Nadeem Manaf,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services team in regards of ticket
ID0442111.
Apologies for the delayed answer.
Today I connected remotely to the charger, and I saw that the charger is in Failsafe mode:
Failsafe mode is a condition when the charger, at the moment of boot-up, does not have communication to one of the fundamental controllers (SECCs, Routers, PLC, Application Board).
Via SSH connection I verified that the charger has no communication to SECC-LE KF12 component:
Therefore, it is necessary to go onsite and replace the faulty component. I loop in this ticket @Balachandar for organization matters.
The spare part required is the following:
